reuse.why: Introduces a month-fill module whose selection, lock and sign helpers every month-wide action (and setNMonthAvg) now uses, and reuses extractTagsFromText for the #fixed tag.

duplication.why: The income rule is a separate predicate that each of the six actions still calls in its own loop with its own isTrackingBudget() capture, and the group-notes/goal_def join is written into both getBudgetData and getMonthFillCategories.

placement.why: Selection rules move into a dedicated server/budget/month-fill.ts next to actions.ts, and the new method is registered with its siblings.

scope.why: Edits are limited to the month-wide actions, the new module, registration, tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: The hidden/template/#fixed rules are decided in one place with an explicit includeHiddenCategories option, though the selection is split across two predicates that every caller must remember to combine.

abstraction_drift.where: isLockedForMonthFill/getMonthFillCategories take includeHiddenCategories (requested option); template and #fixed rules are general clauses of isLockedForMonthFill; all month-wide actions, including setLastMonthSpending and copyPreviousMonth, go through the shared helpers.
